what: Stress test of the shipped WebLLM installer (runtime/providers/adapters/webllm.mjs, model-runtime 1.0.0 as in production 2bbb17e) on 131 synthetic files served by synth-server.mjs: 1 config of 2,361 bytes in scope webllm/config and 130 files of 0.2 to 8 MB in scope webllm/model, 541,002,361 bytes, installed three at a time exactly as the 9B install does, all three cache scopes cleared before each repeat. Harness: stress-harness.js. Scripted calls, not a user gesture.

safari_27_0_mac.note: storage.estimate() for the origin read 42.4 GB used of a 164.9 GB quota after the run and did not drop after deleting every cache (OPFS empty): lazy accounting

not_shown: Whether the 130-of-131 state occurs at 5 GB scale or under quota pressure: 541 MB total was used. 150 repeats of this size never lost a file, so volume, quota or a timing pattern specific to the real CDN files are the remaining suspects. Left alone by John (2026-11-18).
